Places map utility vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume photo location metadata on device covers storefront language. Map clustering, geocoding, and Connect actually separate in-app Places browsing from product-page copy:

  • Photos → Albums → Places — Apple's system surface where buyers browse location-grouped photos and the Places album on device. Controls on-device map and cluster behavior — not App Store language. AppLocale does not perform this.
  • Browse photos on a map — map view with pins or clusters showing where photos were taken. Your listing may show this map story on screenshots; describing buyer-visible map browsing is listing copy, not MapKit engineering.
  • Places album & location clusters — grids and clusters that group photos by city, neighborhood, landmark, or trip region. Product-page copy should describe that workflow; building location-metadata clustering is in-app engineering.
  • Photo map pins — individual pins or heat-style clusters on a map frame. Listing copy names pin and cluster value; implementing map annotation layers is engineering work, not Connect metadata.
  • Location-based albums — albums scoped to a city, neighborhood, vacation, or trip route. zh-Hans copy should describe buyer-visible place albums — 地点相簿 — without inventing geolocation claims your English listing does not state.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of map-browse support in the binary.

Working Places map browsing and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe Places, 地点, and 地点相簿 value on the product page in zh-Hans, not how you wire Core Location, reverse geocoding, MapKit, or PhotoKit location clustering in code.

Places-specific listing copy — 地点 / 地点相簿 / 照片地点 / 地图

Places listings use vocabulary general photo-library guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers describe map-based photo browsing — not a literal paste of US travel-marketing:

Places & 地点 / 地点相簿

US pages use "Places" on the album under Photos → Albums → Places. China storefront copy often uses 地点 for the Places surface and 地点相簿 for location-grouped album grids — especially on Places album tiles and cluster summary frames.

Browse on map & 地图 / 照片地点

Map-view screenshots with pins and clusters are core Places marketing. Chinese buyers expect 地图 for map frames and 照片地点 or 拍照地点 when copy emphasizes where each photo was taken — not English "Map" badges that hide the location-browse hook.

Location clusters & photo map pins

Cluster bubbles, pin stacks, and zoomed city regions appear frequently on Places screenshots. zh-Hans caption lines should name cluster and pin behavior buyers see — paired with the UI your gallery actually shows.

City, neighborhood & trip albums

Location-based albums scoped to a city block, neighborhood, vacation, or road trip need place-specific phrasing. Frames should pair trip-album copy with the geography your English listing claims — without inventing landmark detection your app does not market.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need Places-relevant search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 地点, 地点相簿, and 拍照地点 each signal different intent from 人物和宠物 face-album keywords or 重复项目 duplicate-cleanup terms.

FAQ

Does shipping photo-map browsing auto-fill my China App Store listing?

No. Map clustering, Places album organization, and location-metadata grouping control runtime library behavior — they do not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. If zh-Hans name, subtitle, keywords, description, or screenshot caption fields are empty or still English, the China storefront falls back to en-US copy.

Which App Store Connect fields does AppLocale rewrite?

Paste-ready Simplified Chinese for listing fields you specify: app name, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text when included, and screenshot overlay or caption lines such as Places, Browse on map, Location clusters, 地点, 地点相簿, 照片地点, and 地图 — rewritten from your English originals.

Does AppLocale implement Core Location, MapKit, or location clustering?

No. AppLocale rewrites App Store Connect listing metadata and screenshot caption text only. Core Location permissions, reverse geocoding, MapKit map views, and PhotoKit location-metadata engineering are outside AppLocale scope.

How is this different from Duplicates, People & Pets, Shared Albums, iCloud Photos, and Memories pages?

Photos Places listing copy covers Photos → Albums → Places — map browse, location clusters, photo map pins, and location-based albums on gallery frames. Duplicates listing copy covers merge duplicate photos. People & Pets listing copy covers face-grouped albums. Shared Albums listing copy covers collaborative invites. iCloud Photos listing copy covers cloud library sync. Memories listing copy covers Memory movie reels. Each surface has a separate guide.

Why do my Places screenshot captions still say Places in English on China?

Screenshot overlay lines and caption fields are per localization in App Store Connect. If you never filled zh-Hans caption fields — or pasted English into the Chinese screenshot set — China buyers see Latin script on frames meant to signal 地点, 地点相簿, or 照片地点 value.

Should zh-Hans copy use 地点 or 地图?

地点 and 地点相簿 fit Places album and cluster marketing. 地图 fits map-view screenshots with pins. 照片地点 and 拍照地点 fit frames that emphasize capture location. AppLocale picks phrasing that matches your English claims and screenshot frames.
